I designed a 4th-order Butterworth low-pass filter with a 1 kHz cutoff and applied it to the `three_tones` signal (sample rate 16,000 Hz, Nyquist 8,000 Hz). 

Comparing the FFT spectra before and after filtering, the RMS dropped from 0.2457 to 0.158. The 440 Hz tone was preserved (at 0.1998 amplitude), the 1,000 Hz cutoff frequency was attenuated by approximately -3 dB (amplitude 0.1), and frequencies above the cutoff (such as the 3,000 Hz tone) were effectively removed.
